paragraphs.text: Dean Embrose Lu is a human warlock teacher at the Silverquill College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .

Dean Embrose of Silverquill is a master poet whose ink magic is both dominating and merciless. Quick with a cutting remark, Dean Embrose has seen many mage-students scrub out of Strixhaven and has nothing good to say about those who can't hack it. He has dark hair, dark clothes, and a dark mien.

A cynic, Embrose believes that most people are primarily motivated by self-interest. He demands his students learn how to use language-based magic to "get what they deserve." While he often fought with Dean Shaile , he held a deep, begrudging respect for the owlin .
He is the father of Killian Lu , and is even stricter with him than he is with other students. His parental nature is often shown in implicitly exclusionary behavior.

During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Embrose Lu defeated a host of compleated faculty members, allowing his son and his friends to find the Invocation of the Founders . He and Liliana Vess were two of the few remaining professors in Strixhaven.

Embrose was still Dean of Shadow in 4565, three years after the invasion. That year, he published Winnowing Season , his first publication since the Invasion. During renewed tensions between Silkmeadow and Tor-Kathorr, Lu was summoned to the Forum of Amity to conduct a Naming Tithe ritual, which restored formal order but failed to resolve the deeper grievances. Soon afterward, Crownflower and Verdis prepared to settle the dispute through a binding duel that could have resulted in death. Killian intervened by creating his own sigil to bear witness, reshaping the duel and its terms to emphasize shared responsibility and communion. Killian documented the new approach as a potential addendum to the Naming Tithe ritual and shared it with his father, whose poetry had provided its inspiration.
